context: A Facebook comment under a post by the National Institute of Public Health of Kosovo during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020. The comment is in Albanian, mostly the informal Kosovo (Gheg) dialect, often written without the letters ë and ç.
answer: {"question":"What overall sentiment does this Kosovo Facebook comment express toward the COVID-19 situation, the health institute, or the people involved?","rule":"Positive means praise, thanks, good wishes, prayers for recovery, or joy at falling cases or rising recoveries.
